topics.title: Write a paragraph about a hobby you like.
guiding_questions: How often do you practise it?
Who do you practise it with?
topics.sample_essay: My favourite hobby is swimming. I like it because it makes me feel healthy and strong. I practise swimming three times a week at the sports centre. I usually go with my friend Rami. We have a lot of fun together. Swimming helps me relax after a long day at school. I also like to watch swimming competitions on TV. I hope to become a good swimmer one day.
